title: Subtract
summary: SUBTRACT', verb transitive [Latin subtraho, subtractus; sub and traho, to draw.] To withdraw or take a part from the rest; to deduct. subtract 5 from 9, and the remainder is 4.

inlines.v: SUBTRACT', verb transitive [Latin subtraho, subtractus; sub and traho, to draw.] To withdraw or take a part from the rest; to deduct. subtract 5 from 9, and the remainder is 4.
